task.title: Adding a Window Capture Source
task.shortdesc: Capture a single application window instead of the whole screen.

context.p: Window Capture follows one window even if you move or resize it, and unlike Display Capture it won't show anything from other applications layered on top.

step.cmd: In the Sources panel, click + and choose Window Capture.
Select the target application from the Window dropdown.
step.info: The target application must already be running.

step.cmd: Choose a capture method if prompted.
step.info: Most modern applications work with the default method; older or hardware-accelerated applications sometimes need an alternate capture method to render correctly.

taskbody.result: The chosen window appears in the scene and continues updating even if the window is minimized behind other windows (though not while fully minimized).
